name.value: KJA Ventures Shopping Centre & Online Pickup

description.value: KJA Ventures is a family-run general store and freight hub in Fort St. John, stocking branded snacks, drinks, household goods, and toiletries at wholesale prices. It also serves as an authorized parcel handling point for UPS, FedEx Express, Loomis, DHL, Canpar, and Canada Post, making it a useful stop for resupply and logistics in this remote northern BC community. Customer reviews highlight the friendly, community-minded ownership and a broad selection of everyday essentials.

address.value: 10528 Alaska Rd N, Fort St John, V1J 1B3
